name: A Runnable Target Operating Model
instructions: Section is already set: Role, Process, Step, Rule, or System.
Name is what you call it.
Who is the role accountable for that row. Fill it on a Process and a Step. Leave it blank on a Role, a Rule, and a System.
Put each Step under the Process it belongs to. The Who on a Step is a Role you named.
Add a row when you need another one, and keep its Section name.

example.name: Operations lead
example.what: Owns the work from the first step to the last.

example.name: Fulfill an order
example.what: Starts when a customer pays. Ends when delivery is confirmed.

example.name: Check the payment
example.what: Do not continue until the payment has cleared.

example.name: Hand the order on
example.what: The next role starts from this step.

example.name: Payment before the handoff
example.what: No work moves on until the payment has cleared.

example.name: Order system
example.what: Holds the order and the payment state.
